items.topic: KindRouter B事务：锁序、confirmed→draft、old/new set与reconfirm exactly-once

promotion 唯一锁序固定为 maintenance gate → bid_kind_router_current → open projects按UUID → clauses按UUID → procedural identities；confirmed kind变化必须先 confirmed→draft，以OLD row退出matching及原service/family-NULL集合，再写新kind/family且保持draft，见 plans/bid-platform-complete-solution.md:193。
待确认marker与promotion generation持久化；只有durable user/api_key携带expected clause revision并验证current generation的正常confirm才能原子清marker并进入NEW集合，manual PATCH不能绕过，见 plans/bid-platform-complete-solution.md:195。
